# ApeSDK 0.712

ApeSDK 0.712 establishes two separately tested desktop release products from the shared Mac Catalyst project: a native macOS AppKit build and an iOS-derived Mac Catalyst build. The project now maintains correctly wired app icons, Swift Testing parity coverage for both variants, refreshed iOS and iPadOS orientation support, and terrain-window movie generation. The command-line and Linux path now receives the same first-class attention through consolidated test entry points, stronger build-failure handling, deterministic regression scenarios, and a clearer coverage workflow.

This release also adds a browser-facing WebAssembly build that compiles the shared C simulation with `WASM_BUILD` rather than a duplicated engine. Its graphical View, Terrain, and Control canvases use the shared drawing and lifecycle path, accept mouse, keyboard, and menu interaction, and are packaged with a local Emscripten build-and-serve workflow. Release documentation now distinguishes the native macOS and Mac Catalyst ZIPs and source archive, while CI retains normal Linux GCC/Clang, coverage, native macOS, and Catalyst testing; the unstable combined sanitizer lane has been temporarily removed.
